newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pegasus Holdings IPO 16.48 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus Holdings IPO 16.48 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Sports shoes manufacturer Pegasus Holdings Ltd said on Monday its initial public offering was 16.48 times oversubscribed.

The company offered 180.3 million new shares at HK$1.08 per share and received applications for 2.84 billion shares. It said 18.03 million new shares had been offered on a preferential basis to employees which were fully applied for.
Trading in Pegasus Holdings shares is expected to begin on October 11, the company said.
"The board of directors will strive to expand and maintain the profitability and prosperity of Pegasus Holdings Limited," chairman Thomas Wu said in a statement.
